description: The shortest X-FrameOS-Next-Render a control plane gives a board it renders for, by the board's panel format (fos_pixel_format_t, embedded/esp32/components/frameos_display/include/frameos_display.h; the format a render pull names is all both planes know of the panel). A colour e-paper panel's full refresh takes 15-30 s and its makers ask for minutes between refreshes, so a scene's 10 s interval must not make it flash nonstop (a Pimoroni Inky Frame 7.3" Spectra was told 10 s, 2026-11-15). A format not listed has no panel floor; the plane's own floor still holds. Each case: the seconds the scene asked for (`wanted`, null: no opinion), the plane's own floor (`planeFloor`) and the answer (`seconds`). docs/server-rendering.md "When the next picture is due". Mirrored by PANEL_REFRESH_FLOOR_SECONDS in backend/app/api/embedded_device.py and panelRefreshFloorSeconds in cloud/apps/auth-web/src/lib/server-render.ts; backend/app/api/tests/test_panel_refresh_floors.py and cloud/apps/auth-web/src/lib/server-render.test.ts read this file.

7.panel: Spectra 6 (Waveshare 7.3" E, 13.3" E, PhotoPainter, Inky Frame 7.3" Spectra)
